name: recyclarr
title: Recyclarr
description: Copies the TRaSH Guides' quality definitions, custom formats and quality profiles into Sonarr and Radarr and keeps them current on a schedule. It has no web page: after the first start, edit App-Data/Recyclarr/recyclarr.yml (the address and API key of each app, and the profiles you want) and it syncs at the next run. To sync at once: docker exec Recyclarr recyclarr sync.

variables.name: RECYCLARR_SCHEDULE
variables.label: Schedule
variables.description: When the sync runs: @hourly, @daily, @weekly or a cron expression like 0 4 * * *
